response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT DISTINCT tr.tradereg, tr.tradekind FROM transactionrecord t JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg), counts AS (SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM matched GROUP BY tradekind), stats AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt, SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM counts) SELECT c.tradekind AS trader_type, c.cnt AS trader_count, c.cnt * 1.0 / s.total_cnt AS share_of_total, c.cnt - s.avg_cnt AS diff_from_average FROM counts c CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE s.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL AND c.cnt > s.avg_cnt
